table.retrieve:
SELECT  invcode=saleledger.saleinvcode,
	saleledger.saleCatCode,
	type   =CASE saleledger.saleCatCode 
		WHEN 1 THEN 'Cash' 
		WHEN 3 THEN 'Cash' 
		ELSE 'Credit' 
		END,
	Date    = saleledger.date,
	Gross=SUM(saledetail.looseqty*saledetail.saleprice),
	Discount=SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.itemflatdisc)+
		SUM((saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
		(.01 * saledetail.discperc)) + 
		(SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) +
		saleledger.flatdisc,
	Other= saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax, 
	SaleValue=ROUND(SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
		saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0),
	SaleTax=Round(SUM( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty)* saledetail.unitsalestax)+
		SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
		saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0),
	UserCode=saleledger.salesmancode,
	UserName=Users.UserName,
	Diff=SUM(saledetail.looseqty * ABS(saledetail.SalePrice - saledetail.Rate))

FROM saleledger, saledetail, users

WHERE
	saleledger.date >= :ar_startdate AND saleledger.date <= :ar_enddate AND
	saleledger.salesmancode in (:ar_usercode) AND
	saleledger.salecatcode in (:aa_saletype) AND
	saleledger.salesmancode = Users.UserCode AND
	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode

GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 saleledger.custcode, 
	 saleledger.salecatcode,
	 saleledger.date,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.misccharges,
	 saleledger.salestax,
	 saleledger.flatdisc,
	 saleledger.invgstperc1,
	 saleledger.salesmancode,
	 Users.UserName
UNION ALL
SELECT  invcode=saleledger.saleinvcode,
	saleledger.saleCatCode,
	type   =CASE saleledger.saleCatCode 
		WHEN 1 THEN 'Cash' 
		WHEN 3 THEN 'Cash' 
		ELSE 'Credit'
		END,
	Date    = saleledger.date,
	Gross=SUM(saledetail.looseqty*saledetail.saleprice),
	Discount=SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.itemflatdisc)+
		SUM((saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
		(.01 * saledetail.discperc)) + 
		(SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) +
		saleledger.flatdisc,
	Other= saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax, 
	SaleValue=ROUND(SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
		saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0),
	SaleTax=Round(SUM( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty)* saledetail.unitsalestax)+
		SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
		saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0),
	UserCode=saleledger.salesmancode,
	UserName=Users.UserName,
	Diff=SUM(saledetail.looseqty * ABS(saledetail.SalePrice - saledetail.Rate))

FROM saleledger, saleinvdetail saledetail, users

WHERE
	SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND
	saleledger.date >= :ar_startdate AND saleledger.date <= :ar_enddate AND
	saleledger.salesmancode in (:ar_usercode) AND
	saleledger.salecatcode in (:aa_saletype) AND
	saleledger.salesmancode = Users.UserCode AND
	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode

GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 saleledger.custcode, 
	 saleledger.salecatcode,
	 saleledger.date,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.misccharges,
	 saleledger.salestax,
	 saleledger.flatdisc,
	 saleledger.invgstperc1,
	 saleledger.salesmancode,
	 Users.UserName
Order By
	 Users.UserName,
	 saleledger.salesmancode,
	 saleledger.date,
	 saleledger.saleinvcode

objects.name: repdisc
objects.expression: sum(discount for all) / if(sum(gross for all) >0, sum(gross for all) ,1)

objects.name: userdisc
objects.expression: sum(discount for group 1) / if(sum(gross for group 1) >0, sum(gross for group 1) ,1)
